body: An American Airlines Airbus A321-200, registration N154UW, operating flight AA-1419 from Fort Lauderdale, Florida, to Charlotte, North Carolina, with 230 people on board, was climbing out of Fort Lauderdale's runway 28R when the crew declared PAN PAN, reporting they had hit a flock of birds and had vibrations of the right-hand engine (CFM56).
The crew stopped the climb at 4000 feet and returned to Fort Lauderdale for a safe landing on runway 28R about 20 minutes after departure.
en.summary: An American Airlines A321 struck a flock of birds shortly after departing Fort Lauderdale, with vibrations in the right engine; the crew declared PAN PAN and returned for a safe landing about 20 minutes after departure.
en.title: American A321 returns to Fort Lauderdale after bird strike on climb-out

body: 美國航空一架空中巴士A321-200客機，註冊編號N154UW，執行AA-1419班機自佛羅里達州勞德岱堡飛往北卡羅來納州夏洛特，機上230人。客機自28R跑道起飛爬升時撞上鳥群，機組發出PAN PAN通報，右發動機（CFM56）出現震動。
機組在4000英尺高度停止爬升，折返勞德岱堡，起飛約20分鐘後安全降落28R跑道。
zh.summary: 美國航空一架A321客機自勞德岱堡起飛後撞上鳥群，右發動機出現震動，機組發出PAN PAN並折返，起飛約20分鐘後安全降落。
zh.title: 美航A321客機起飛後撞上鳥群　右發動機震動折返勞德岱堡
